decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - Before commencement of operations, a method scheme shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority detailing the routes and types of construction traffic.

Condition : 5 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 08.00  to  18.00 on Mondays to Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - Before commencement of operations, a scheme shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority to cover the following matters:

(i)	any external illumination of the site

(ii)	measures to ensure that all mud and other loose materials are not carried on the wheels and chassis of any vehicles leaving the site; and

(iii)	measures to minimise dust nuisance caused by the operations and to ensure that no dust or other debris is carried on to the adjoining properties.

The scheme so approved should be fully implemented.

Condition : 8 - Informative - The Council's West Area Committee (Planning) requests that every effort be made to carry out the works hereby approved during school holidays so as to minimise disturbane the pupil education.
description: The demolition of three existing portable buildings and the erection of a single storey extension to the rear of the existing school.
